Lumbini Lions clinched a thrilling 4-wicket win over Biratnagar Kings, sealing the victory with just 1 ball to spare!
The Lions held their nerve in a close finish to chase down the target and secure a crucial win in Match 26 of the Nepal Premier League 2026!
